set.body: Separate baseline basis construction, nuisance preparation, nuisance validation/cleaning, model assembly, and report formatting out of the monolithic BaselineModel surface. Add BaselineError and buildEither/checkEither/cleanEither wrappers while keeping legacy APIs. Acceptance: nuisance and baseline edge failures are structured, not only IllegalArgumentException messages; existing BaselineModelSuite coverage remains green.
set.title: Design: split BaselineModel and add BaselineError
